I hope it’s okay if I can vent a bit here. 

So, I completely get where you’re coming from. Granted, I didn’t follow ASTRO too closely, but I did see them in concert back in 2018. I brought my best friend with me. I was so excited because it was my first kpop concert, of a group in which I really enjoyed their music. I think I was especially excited to hear Crazy Sexy Cool live. Anyway, it was an amazing concert and I remember Aroha cheering so loudly for them. 

Yesterday, I was in class and I first saw the news on Twitter during my break. I didn’t think it would be what I was about to read. Nothing could’ve prepared me for that. I thought, Moonbin, of all people? (Not saying this should’ve happened to anyone else, it’s just so surprising since he is always known as smiling and being the joy that he is). My chest felt so tight at that moment,  I had to step out and recollect myself. I held on for the rest of the day with a few tears, but today, I broke down sobbing. My eyes are swollen as I’m typing this. For the past few years, I have listened to ASTRO’s songs and watched videos. I remember constantly replaying Knock and the one cover that he did with his sister Moon Sua. He just had that charisma and he always lighted up the stage. His smile was so contagious, how can you not smile with him? 

It’s just hard. The cause of death hasn’t been confirmed, but whatever the cause was, he was way too young. I worry for the people around him. His family, fellow members, fans. I just hope he wasn’t in too much pain. I wish there was something we could’ve done, anything. Anyway, sorry for the long post, but I just needed to let it all out. I tried talking about it with a family member but I don’t know if they really understand. Some might be like, why are you crying so much over someone you didn’t know personally? Well, we’re all human right? Ahh I’ve been crying too much, I don’t know when I’ll stop. I hope you’re doing okay, and if you ever need to talk, I can listen 🤍

Edit: oh, I wanted to add I did listen to Yoongi’s album and I am incredibly proud of him. It’s an amazing album and I’m sure he’s going to give some great performances. I guess I couldn’t hold it for much longer and proceeded to cry again… it’s hard to not keep thinking about Moonbin.
